about.title: about
about.paragraph_1: this is a reinterpretation of traditional porcelain animal sculpture through the prism of archaic tribal tattoo art. classical animal figurines, symbols of salon refinement, acquire a new meaning as they are covered with powerful ritual ornaments. it is a collision of two aesthetics: the fragile purity of porcelain and the wild energy of underground culture.
about.paragraph_2: the result is a set of unique artefacts existing at the intersection of eras. the elegant form recalls the past, while the graphic tattoos speak in a symbolic language about the character of the present. each figurine becomes not an object of admiration but a bearer of history, intertwining eternal nature with the ritual of inscribing signs. it is a dialogue in which refinement meets strength.
